about: Every job a Workshop tool does, as a plain verb phrase with its ONE owner folder and entry. A new file of any kind is admitted only under the owner of a row or under a place (content and the repository's own files); anywhere else it is refused with the nearest rows named. A row for a job another row already does, here or in another repository, is refused and pointed at that owner, and so is a row NEAR one by shared words, or one a local judge calls the same job, unless it says in distinct_from how its job differs. A row whose code still lives elsewhere names lives_at (where it is now, by repository-relative name) and moves_to (the folder here that owns it): porting it in is extending that owner. To add a tool: find the row whose job it is first; add a row only for a job no row does, before the code.
owner_globs: Repository-relative. `*` is any characters but /, `**` any characters, `?` one character but /; a match also covers everything under a matched folder.

places.holds: what the Workshop is and how a tool folder is laid out
the licence classes a tool row may declare
the Workshop's package manifest and test command
the tests every tool row is checked by
